This is API documentation for service providers adding services to the MSPECS system
# Introduction
This documentation describes the interface between the provider and the MSPECS system. The API documentation describes endpoints and webhooks for the service provider to implement and endpoints in the MSPECS system which a service provider uses to retrieve data about an subscriber (organization) and the subscribers published deals.
The goal with this API is to provide an easy way to plug in new services to the MSPECS system.

There are two parts in this documentation, one general for all services and one for a specific type of service.
* Provider services documentation describes common requirements for all integrating providers.
* Marketing provider documentation describes requirements for providers integrating marketing services such as websites and market places.

# Prerequisites
* The service provider must have an agreement with MSPECS for the services to provide. The provider will need to specify some information including an URL for the webhook where to receive events for add/remove subscribers. Having an agreement the provider will receive a `provider account` to be used for this integration.
* To be integrated in the prodution environment the service provider must implement the `Provider service endpoints` and `Provider service webhooks`. If you are a provider of deal services you will also need to implement the `Deal service provider webhooks` and/or if you are a marketing provider you need to implement the `Marketing provider webhooks`.

# Provider services overview
This is just an overview to describe the intended flow of the API. Any details for the endpoints are specified below.
All providers should manage their services and subscribers. Managing service is creating them and keeping information up to date. As for subscribers the provider will receive events when a subscriber adds a service or removes a service.
## Provider - manage information about current provider
Providers can maintain information about themselves, i.e. update and retrieve them.
1. [Update provider information](#tag/Provider/paths/~1api~1provider/put).
1. [Retrieve provider information](#tag/Provider/paths/~1api~1provider/get).

## Service provider - manage services
The service providers can maintain their own services, i.e. create, update and retrieve them.
1. [Create a service](#tag/Provider-services/paths/~1api~1provider~1services/post).
1. [Update a service](#tag/Provider-services/paths/~1api~1provider~1services~1{id}/put).
1. [Retrieve a service by ID](#tag/Provider-services/paths/~1api~1provider~1services~1{id}/get) including any object types.
1. [Retrieve all services](#tag/Provider-services/paths/~1api~1provider~1services/get).

## Service provider - client information endpoint
Provider should implement an information page for items published to the provider. What this information page contains will depend on the type of service and provider, e.g. it could be statistics from the provider system for the published item.

This is an URL the provider specifies for each service.
This URL must take a token (jwt token) as a path parameter. To validate and extract the information from this jwt token the provider has two options, retrieve a verify key via the API and validate locally or use a validation endpoint in the API, see 'Validating tokens' below.
1. A user at the subscriber selects to "see this deal at the provider" in MSPECS.
1. The user is redirected to the provider's [Provider endpoint display published deal](#tag/Provider-service-endpoints/paths/~1clientEndpointUrl~1at~1provider/get).
1. The provider should validate the jwt token received in the request. After successful validation the provider retrieves information about the service and deal the jwt token is pointing to and renders some Information page.

### Validating token
The jwt token is signed and can be validated using one of the following methods:
* Validate locally
    - Provider fetches the [Fetch key for validating JWT Token locally](#tag/Provider-validate/paths/~1api~1provider~1services~1verify~1Key/get) verifies the JWT Token and extracts the payload.
        - Validating locally eliminates the need for a round trip to MSPECS every time the provider receives a call to the "Provider endpoint display published deal".
        - The key for validation is a PEM encoded certificate and contains a 'Valid To' date and can be cached.
* Validate using validation endpoint
    - Provider validates the jwt token by sending a [validation request to MSPECS](#tag/Provider-validate/paths/~1api~1provider~1services~1validate~1{jwtToken}/get) which returns the validated payload.


## Subscriber (realtor organization) adds a provider service
1. When a Subscriber wants to use a provider service they will add it to their organization in MSPECS.
1. MSPECS will send (POST) an event to the service provider's [Subscription event webhook](#operation/subscriptionEvent) with event type 'SUBSCRIBER_ADDED'.
1. Upon receiving the event the service provider returns a 200 OK response before starting any lengthy internal processing.
1. The service provider can fetch more details about the subscriber from the [Retrieve subscriber details](#tag/Marketing-subscriber/paths/~1api~1marketing~1subscriber/get) endpoint.

## Subscriber updates information relevant for the provider service
1. An Organization updates some information about itself relevant for a provider service in MSPECS.
1. MSPECS will send (POST) an event to the service provider's [Subscription event webhook](#operation/subscriptionEvent) with event type 'SUBSCRIBER_UPDATED'.
1. Upon receiving the event the service provider returns a 200 OK response before starting any lengthy internal processing.

## Subscriber removes a provider service
1. When an Organization wants to remove a provider service they will remove it from their organization in MSPECS.
1. MSPECS will send (POST) an event to the service provider's [Subscription event webhook](#operation/subscriptionEvent) with event type 'SUBSCRIBER_REMOVED'.
1. Upon receiving the event the service provider returns a 200 OK response before starting any lengthy internal processing.

## Sync missing events; subscribers (subscribe/unsubscribe)
There is an endpoint in MSPECS for fetching all subscribers for a provider service, [Retrieves all subscribers](#tag/Provider-subscribers/paths/~1api~1provider~1subscribers/get). This endpoint should be requested once every night to sync that all organizations subscribing the service are present.
If a subscriber is not in the get all organization query then it should be removed from the service provider.
Only retrieve data about a subscriber if you get a webhook saying to update the subscriber or to sync a missing subscriber.
Do not crontab or schedule in any other way to retrieve deal data. Only retrieve when needed.

## Pending Activation
- If the service have `isPendingSubscriberActivation = true` service subscriptions won't automatically be activated, they will be in a pending stage untill the service provider activates it.
- This flow will allow the providers to publish their services and get notified when a license wants to subscribe to it. But it will prevent the license from using the service until the provider approves the usage.
- The approval can be dependent on contracts being signed or any other steps needed before the service can be used.
- If pending activation is activated and office subscriptions is activated each office subscription needs to be approved as well

To get a self-service flow we recommend using pending activation in combination with `services.subscriberActivationType=ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_SUBSCRIBER_ACTIVATION_TYPE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT`. This will allow the following flow:
1. The license/office subscribes to the service
1. The service subscription is set in a pending state
1. The user who subscribes to the service will get redirected to the url in `services.subscriberClientEndpointUrl` with a JWT in the URL
1. The provider can decode the JWT and see information about the organization and can retrieve subscriber information from our API
1. The provider can show a document that needs to be signed or information how the license should proceed to get the subscription approved
1. When all prerequisites are met the provider can approve the subscription. [License approve](#tag/Provider-subscribers/paths/~1api~1provider~1subscriber/put) or [Office approve](#tag/Provider-subscribers/paths/~1api~1provider~1subscriber~1office~1{id}/put)

# Marketing provider overview
This is just an overview to describe the intended flows of the API. Any details for the endpoints are specified below.
## Publish a Deal to a marketing provider
1. When a Subscriber wants to publish a deal to a marketing provider they will publish it in MSPECS and we set it as pending.
1. MSPECS will send (POST) an event to the marketing provider's [Publish deal event webhook](#operation/publishDealEvent) with the event type 'PUBLISH'.
1. Upon receiving the event the service provider returns a 200 OK response before starting any lengthy internal processing.
1. The service provider can fetch full details about the deal from the [Retrieve deal by ID](#tag/Marketing-deal/paths/~1api~1marketing~1deals~1{dealId}/get) endpoint.
1. If the deal is a project, the service provider can fetch all deals belonging to that project using [Retrieve deals belonging to a project](#tag/Marketing-deal/paths/~1api~1marketing~1deals~1{projectDealId}~1deals/get)
1. When the service provider is done processing the data and has successfully published the deal. The service provider will update MSPECS by sending a message to the [Change publication status of a Deal](#tag/Marketing-deal/paths/~1api~1marketing~1deals~1status~1{dealId}/put) endpoint.

## Publish a sold Deal to a marketing provider
1. When a Subscriber wants to publish a sold deal to a marketing provider they will publish it in MSPECS.The deal will be set to status sold in MSPECS.
MSPECS will send (POST) an event to the marketing provider's [Publish deal event webhook](#operation/publishDealEvent) with the event type 'PUBLISH' and saleStatus 'ENUMS_SALE_STATUS_SOLD'.
1. Upon receiving the event the service provider returns a 200 OK response before starting any lengthy internal processing.
1. The service provider can fetch full details about the deal from the [Retrieve deal by ID](#tag/Marketing-deal/paths/~1api~1marketing~1deals~1{dealId}/get) endpoint.
1. When the service provider is done processing the data and has successfully published the sold deal. The service provider will update MSPECS by sending a message to the [Change publication status of a Deal](#tag/Marketing-deal/paths/~1api~1marketing~1deals~1status~1{dealId}/put) endpoint.

## Unpublish a Deal from a provider service
1. When an Subscriber wants to un-publish a deal from a service provider they will unpublish it in MSPECS.
1. MSPECS will send (POST) an event to the service provider's [Publish deal event webhook](#operation/publishDealEvent) with event type 'UN_PUBLISH'.
1. Upon receiving the event the service provider returns a 200 OK response before starting any lengthy internal processing.
1. The service provider should unpublish the deal.

When the provider have successfully published the deal, then the provider will set the deal as published. If the data couldn't be parsed then the provider can set it as un published.

The idea behind this flow is to avoid any hanging threads and long load times and possible timeouts for the user.

With this flow MSPECS will tell the provider that information is available about a specific deal.
MSPECS doesn't know if the provider will successfully parse the information regarding the deal, that is why we set it as pending.

## Sync missing events; deals (publish/unpublish)
There is one endpoint in MSPECS for fetching all published deals for a subscriber, [Retrieve published deals](#tag/Marketing-deal/paths/~1api~1marketing~1deals/get) and another to fetch published sold deals, []().
### Published deals
If a deal is not in the published deal query then it should be removed from the marketing place.
Only retrieve data about a deal if you get a webhook saying to update the deal or to sync a missing deal.
Do not crontab or schedule in any other way to retrieve deal data. Only retrieve when needed.
### Sold published deals
Since sold published deals can be a very long list, it is paginated. The list is sorted on descending order of field 'updated'.
If a sold deal is not in the published deal query then it should be removed from the marketing place.
Only retrieve data about a deal if you get a webhook saying to update the deal or to sync a missing deal.
Do not crontab or schedule in any other way to retrieve deal data. Only retrieve when needed.


# Organization provider service overview
The organization provider service allows for a provider to extract organizational data for the broker organization.

In the [Subscription event webhook](#operation/subscriptionEvent) the provider is notified about the broker organization subscribing to the service. This information contains the subscriberId and the organizations id.

With this information it is possible for the provider to fetch the organizational information using [Retrieve broker organization details](#tag/Broker-organization/paths/~1api~1organization~1brokerOrganization~1{organizationId}/get).


# Statistics provider service overview
The statistics provider service allows for a provider to extract statistics data for the broker organization. Currently, the only statistics supplied is Sold deals, i.e. deals having a past contract date set.

In the [Subscription event webhook](#operation/subscriptionEvent) the provider is notified about the broker organization subscribing to the service. This information contains the subscriberId and the organizations id.

With this information it is possible for the provider to fetch the statistics information using [Retrieve statistics](#tag/Statistics/paths/~1api~1statistics~1sold~1deals~1from~1{fromDate}~1to~1{toDate}/get).


# Intended use of the API
The service provider should implement the 'Provider services' and the service specific parts, e.g. a marketing provider should implement endpoints for receiving events for subscribe/unsubscribe and client endpoint url as well as endpoints for publish/unpublish.

The API is rate-limited, if we notice misuse of the API we will disable the user. Read the recommendations regarding sync of missing events.

# Servers
| Env   | Integration endpoint | Client endpoint |
| ---   | ---------------------------------- | -----------------------|
| Prod  | https://integration.mspecs.se | https://login.mspecs.se |
| Stage | https://test-integration.mspecs.se | https://stage.mspecs.se / https://demo.mspecs.se |

# Authentication
All calls to the API needs to be authenticated.
The recommended authentication is using BASIC-AUTH combined with using a cookie jar.

If the request contains the cookie "connect.sid" and the session is still valid then the requests will faster.
If the session is invalid, then you will be logged in if you send the basic authent headers as well.

Basic authent is provided through the `Authorization` HTTP header. It must have a value of `Basic <username>:<password>`

Curl examples for authent:

`curl -u"username:password" https://test-integration.mspecs.se/api/provider/subscribers`

`curl -H"Authorization: Basic dXNlcm5hbWU6cGFzc3dvcmQ=" https://test-integration.mspecs.se/api/provider/subscribers`

Curl examples for authent against a subscription:

`curl -u"username:password" -H "subscriber-id:id" https://test-integration.mspecs.se/api/marketing/deals`

`curl -H"Authorization: Basic dXNlcm5hbWU6cGFzc3dvcmQ=" -H "subscriber-id:MDS240smDM.." https://test-integration.mspecs.se/api/marketing/deals`

# Authorization
Only users having 'provider accounts' are allowed to call this API.
For a `marketing provider`, most endpoints require authorization using a header, `subscriber-id`. The value for this header is part of the event sent to the `Provider service callback` or `Publish Deal callback` endpoints, the `subscriberId` value.

# Paging
Where applicable, the API supports paging. Details will be specified in the API documentation for each endpoint.

# Webhook validation

### Create secret
To enable webhook signatures a secret needs to be created. Secrets can be generated [here](#tag/Provider-validate/paths/~1api~1provider~1webhookSecret/put)

### Structure
The incoming request will include a header `x-mspecs-signature`. The header consists of two parts seperated by a comma `,`. The first part is a timestamp(UNIX timestamp), with the key `t`, followed by the message signature in the format [HMAC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hash-based_message_authentication_code) with [SHA-256](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-2), with the key `s`.

Example header:
```
x-mspecs-signature: t=1654088142,s=4c4049d554262c390b059a5b20b204d66bdde7b03d7b12b1ef56d44541e3e26b
```

### How to verify the webhook
To validate the signature, you must recreate it on your end, and then compare it. You will need:

- The webhook secret
- The timestamp of the request (t value in the header)
- The body of the request (The body needs to be exacly as recieved, not JSON parsed or anything)

#### Example
```
const crypto = require("crypto");

const headerTimestamp = '1654088142';
const headerSignature = '4c4049d554262c390b059a5b20b204d66bdde7b03d7b12b1ef56d44541e3e26b';
const rawRequestBody = '{"eventType":"PUBLISH","accessToken":"MDAtMXwwMDAwMDAwMDAwMnwyODQ.","subscriberId":"MDAtMXwwMDAwMDAwMDAwMnwyODQ.","dealId":"MDAwNHwwMDAwMDAwMDc1NHw1OA..","saleStatus":"ENUMS_SALE_STATUS_FOR_SALE","isPreview":false}'
const secret = '237542a0e1aa11ec9415bf7193203fb7';

const message = headerTimestamp + '.' + rawRequestBody;

const calculatedSignature = crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(message).digest('hex');

console.log('Signatures match: ' + (headerSignature === calculatedSignature));
```

The calculated signature should match prefectly with the recieved signature. If they do not match something is wrong and the request should be ignored.

# Files/Images
All files and images should be downloaded and served by the service provider.

We will in the future return URLS with a time to live period. This will make the URL invalid after a set time period.
Since we warn about this change now, the change will take effect without any grace period or transition period.

# Translations
This API returns both the translation constant and the translated value.

The translations may be changed to better suit the MSPECS system without any notice.

# Access Grants

Some data is more sensitive and it’s restricted. Buyer and seller data contains GDPR regulated information. To be able to only expose information necessary, the information is requested in several parts. Any service should only request information necessary for providing the service.
The provider will only be able to access data for which they have been granted access. Data fields requiring access grants are marked in the API documentation.

For services to gain access to these data you will need to contact us. We need to know the following information:
- Which service is the data needed for?
- Which data is needed?
- Why is it needed?
- Is it GDPR compliant?

# Stability guarantee
Most of the API:s are now stable. API:s who are not stable are marked as BETA

NB! Services of other types than "ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_TYPE_DEAL" can only subscribe to ORGANIZATION (BASE, USERS, OFFICES) events.
 Notification for changes in data is divided into data chunks the provider can subscribe to. The data partition corresponds to the parts fetched in the subscriber and deal service APIs. This is to avoid having to receive events for data changes that is of no interest to the provider.<details>
<summary>
Enums
</summary>

| Constant | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| ORGANIZATION_BASE | Changes in the basic organization settings data. Corresponds to the data in "organization" of [Retrieve subscriber details](#tag/Provider-subscribers/paths/~1api~1provider~1subscriber/get) response data. |
| ORGANIZATION_USERS | Changes in a users data. Corresponds to the data in "offices" of [Retrieve subscriber details](#tag/Provider-subscribers/paths/~1api~1provider~1subscriber/get) response data. |
| ORGANIZATION_OFFICES | Changes in a office (sometimes called organization unit). Corresponds to the data in "users" of [Retrieve subscriber details](#tag/Provider-subscribers/paths/~1api~1provider~1subscriber/get) response data. |
| DEAL_BASE | Corresponds to basic deal data in [Retrieve deal by ID](#tag/Deal-service/paths/~1api~1dealService~1deals~1{dealId}/get) response data. |
| DEAL_ESTATE | Corresponds to estate data in [Retrieve deal by ID](#tag/Deal-service/paths/~1api~1dealService~1deals~1{dealId}/get) response data. |
| DEAL_FILES | Corresponds to the data in "files" of [Retrieve deal by ID](#tag/Deal-service/paths/~1api~1dealService~1deals~1{dealId}/get) response data. |
| DEAL_IMAGES | Corresponds to the data in "image" of [Retrieve deal by ID](#tag/Deal-service/paths/~1api~1dealService~1deals~1{dealId}/get) response data. |
| DEAL_BUYERS | Corresponds to the data in "buyers" of [Retrieve deal by ID](#tag/Deal-service/paths/~1api~1dealService~1deals~1{dealId}/get) response data. Requires access grants. |
| DEAL_SELLERS | Corresponds to the data in "sellers" of [Retrieve deal by ID](#tag/Deal-service/paths/~1api~1dealService~1deals~1{dealId}/get) response data. Requires access grants. |
| DEAL_COMMISSION | Corresponds to the data in "commission" of [Retrieve restricted data](#tag/Deal-service/paths/~1api~1dealService~1deals~1{dealId}~1restricted/get) response data. Requires access grants. |
| DEAL_CDS_DOWN_PAYMENT | Corresponds to the data in "cashDefinitiveStatement" of [Retrieve restricted data](#tag/Deal-service/paths/~1api~1dealService~1deals~1{dealId}~1restricted/get) response data. Requires access grants. |
</details>

key.description: Identifier for the configuration entry. Must begin with a letter and only contain letters (a-z), digits (0-9) and underscore (_). May also be an internal sale status enum directly (e.g. ENUMS_SALE_STATUS_SOLD).

value.description: Optional value associated with the key.

mappedTo.description: For saleStatus entries: the internal sale status enum the key maps to (e.g. ENUMS_SALE_STATUS_FOR_SALE).

displayTranslations.description: Localized display labels for this entry. Supported language keys: sv, en, no, fi, es, pt, da, fr, nl, de.

provider_providerServiceConfiguration.description: If specific configuration is needed for this service,

saleStatus.description:
Provider specific sale statuses for marketing services. The broker publishes deals using one of the keys defined here.

Each entry has:
- key: provider-defined status key. Sent in publish payloads as saleStatus. May also be an internal sale status enum directly.
- mappedTo: Internal sale status enum the key maps to. Allowed values: ENUMS_SALE_STATUS_FOR_SALE, ENUMS_SALE_STATUS_COMING, ENUMS_SALE_STATUS_PRE_MARKET, ENUMS_SALE_STATUS_SOLD, ENUMS_SALE_STATUS_RESERVED
- displayTranslations: Localized display labels. When present, clients should render these instead of translating the key. Supported languages: sv, en, no, fi, es, pt, da, fr, nl, de

If empty or omitted, the default internal sale statuses apply.

connectToWebsite.description:
Controls whether publishing a deal to the website (WEBSITE service) also publishes it to this service.
Either a boolean (global default for all organizations) or a map keyed by organizationId, where the value is `true` (whole organization) or an array of organizationUnitIds (only those offices).

clientEndpointUrl.description:
We will redirect the user to this URL when they want to se more information/statistics/order or anything that will be handled on your side.
If you use ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT_PRESENTATION_FRAMED we will instead iframe the URL provided and the user will stay on mspecs.

In the URL we will include a token, this token can be validated in [this](#tag/Provider-validate/paths/~1api~1provider~1services~1validate~1{jwtToken}/get) endpoint.
The URL provided must include a {token} placeholder. When we use the URL we will replace {token} with a JWT token that can be validated.

The token data will contain eventType which will explain why the user was redirected, usually it's REFERRAL.

clientEndpointPresentation.description:
If set to ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT_PRESENTATION_STANDALONE we will open a new tab and redirect the user to that url.
If ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT_PRESENTATION_FRAMED is set we will iframe the URL in mspecs.

Be sure to use https and to have a valid certificate if you use ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT_PRESENTATION_FRAMED<details>
<summary>
Enums
</summary>

| Constant | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT_PRESENTATION_STANDALONE | The user will be redirected to the set URL |
| ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT_PRESENTATION_FRAMED | The URL will be iframed in mspecs |
</details>

subscriberClientEndpointUrl.description:

subscriberActivationType.description:
When a license(organization) subscribes to the service we can notify the provider either by webhook with the URL set in 'subscriberHookURL' or by redirecting the use to the URL provided in subscriberClientEndpointUrl.

</summary>

| ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_SUBSCRIBER_ACTIVATION_TYPE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT | Redirect user to url with {token} replaced with a JWT token containing the same data as in the POST webhook |
</details>

clientEndpointUrl.description:
We will redirect the user to this URL when they want to se more information/statistics/order or anything that will be handled on your side.
If you use ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT_PRESENTATION_FRAMED we will instead iframe the URL provided and the user will stay on mspecs.

In the URL we will include a token, this token can be validated in [this](#tag/Provider-validate/paths/~1api~1provider~1services~1validate~1{jwtToken}/get) endpoint.
The URL provided must include a {token} placeholder. When we use the URL we will replace {token} with a JWT token that can be validated.

The token data will contain eventType which will explain why the user was redirected, usually it's REFERRAL.

clientEndpointPresentation.description:
If set to ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT_PRESENTATION_STANDALONE we will open a new tab and redirect the user to that url.
If ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT_PRESENTATION_FRAMED is set we will iframe the URL in mspecs.

Be sure to use https and to have a valid certificate if you use ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT_PRESENTATION_FRAMED<details>

</summary>

|----------|-------------|

| ENUMS_PROVIDER_SERVICE_CLIENT_ENDPOINT_PRESENTATION_FRAMED | The URL will be iframed in mspecs |
</details>
